competitiveTarget: Beat Zillow / Redfin / Windermere regional market entry pages. Live region stat band, per-city active-count tiles, market FAQ plus FAQPage JSON-LD, Dataset JSON-LD for AI citability, and a broker lead-capture form no aggregator site carries.
note: Hub page at /housing-market. Region-level snapshot (no citySlug = getRegionPulse via MarketSnapshot). Per-city tiles from ONE getMarketPulseCitySnapshots call. Shares the market-report/index.html mockup; a dedicated hub mockup is a follow-up deliverable.

requiredComponents.name: BreadcrumbNav
requiredComponents.section: Home > Housing market, includeJsonLd=false (schemas array on MetadataBlock handles the single BreadcrumbList)

requiredComponents.name: HeroBlock
requiredComponents.section: Full-bleed hero with display H1 'Central Oregon housing market' in Amboqia via DisplayHeading, and data-driven lede from getMarketPulse region row.

requiredComponents.name: MarketSnapshot
requiredComponents.section: Region-level 4-stat band (no citySlug prop = central-oregon region aggregate via getRegionPulse). Active count, median list price, median DOM, months of supply + market verdict.

requiredComponents.name: RelatedAreas
requiredComponents.section: Per-city navigation tiles with live active counts from getMarketPulseCitySnapshots. Each tile links to /housing-market/<city-slug>. eyebrow 'By city', cols=4. The hub's primary navigation.

requiredComponents.name: ContentSection
requiredComponents.section: Cross-link resource tiles: region report, report index, data explorer, cities, communities, homes-for-sale, guides, area guides.

requiredComponents.name: MetadataBlock
requiredComponents.section: breadcrumb + webPage JSON-LD only. The region Dataset + FAQPage are emitted by the /housing-market/central-oregon report so the hub and the report do not emit the same structured market data.

requiredComponents.name: LeadCaptureBlock
requiredComponents.section: Broker inquiry form, variant='inquiry', tone='muted'. onSubmit=submitMarketPageInquiry. Framed as an inquiry, not a report-subscription promise.

requiredComponents.name: CTABar
requiredComponents.section: Broker contact band, tone='navy'. primary '/contact' Schedule a call, secondary 'tel:5412136706' 541.213.6706.

layoutComponents.name: SiteHeader
layoutComponents.note: Not in requiredComponents because the gate checks the route file.

layoutComponents.name: SiteFooter
layoutComponents.note: Not in requiredComponents because the gate checks the route file.

deferredComponents.name: CityComparisonTable
deferredComponents.reason: Hub page uses RelatedAreas tiles for city navigation. CityComparisonTable is appropriate at the region report level (central-oregon page) where a tabular view adds more value.

deferredComponents.name: PriceChart
deferredComponents.reason: Region-level price history chart deferred until a region price-history DAL function is verified. City pages use getPriceHistory(geoType, geoSlug, 'monthly', 24); a region equivalent needs explicit market_stats_cache region row coverage confirmed.

jsonLd.note: Hub is a nav/overview page. The region Dataset + FAQPage are emitted by /housing-market/central-oregon (market-report-region) so the two URLs do not duplicate the same structured market data.

dataLayer.getMarketPulse: lib/data/market/getMarketPulse.ts, market_pulse_live geo_type='region' geo_slug='central-oregon' property_type='A', 10 to 15 min freshness. Used for hero lede and Dataset dateModified.
dataLayer.getMarketPulseCitySnapshots: lib/data/market/getMarketPulseSnapshot.ts, market_pulse_live city rows, used by RelatedAreas active counts.
dataLayer.note: All DAL functions imported from @/lib/data (G8 compliant). No @/app/actions/* imports. MarketSnapshot internally calls getRegionPulse (no citySlug prop) — the component owns that data fetch.
